big_picture: This line tests physical-balance and real-time fundamental mechanisms as part of the wider goal of understanding Henry Hub before prediction or model selection.

historical_facts.does_not_rule_out: Modern production, consumption, power and LNG balance channels remain unproven by this source and require separate evidence. feas-022 does not rule out a future target-matched physical-balance diagnostic after the capacity rule and GO criterion are explicitly validated, exact mapping and an eligible-month manifest are established, target-month PIT physical forecasts are defensibly specified/constructed as warranted, and prospective confirmation is preserved under a new scored identity.
historical_facts.observed: rep-012 independently reproduces the Roberts/Brown-Yucel source-period VECM and Table 6 physical controls. rep-014 remains an independently reproduced real-time forecasting result with a capacity-held translation. rep-021 produced narrower historical successor evidence and remains INCONCLUSIVE; its acceptance review found that it did not implement #348's intended target-matched futures baseline or target-period physical-input comparison. feas-022 then assessed the intended mapping without fitting or scoring outcomes: exact Databento delivery-month mapping is technically constructible; BHLR prior-month vintages contain 0 of 164 next-target-month values for each of dry production, working storage and total consumption; and the current exposure-restricted exact-market/realized-target upper bound is 136 months. Under the stated Gaussian planning approximation, the primary three-month screen requires 301 OOS months for a 1% MDE versus zero at paired-error correlation 0.9995; that estimate is conditional and does not evaluate the full survivor rule or the precision needed to rule out effects of 1% or more.
historical_facts.rules_out: A stable Brown-Yucel oil-gas cointegrating relation cannot be assumed after 2007, so the historical VECM cannot be directly promoted as a modern predictive model. feas-022 also rules out immediate GO for the intended #348 mapping under the current source/capacity state; it does not rule out a later redesigned successor after the named HOLD remedies are met.

programme_interpretation: Line 005 has successful rep-012/014 literature reproductions, rep-021 narrower INCONCLUSIVE successor evidence, and feas-022 outcome-blind feasibility evidence for #348's intended target-matched mapping. feas-022 ends HOLD pending named data/capacity remedies: target-month PIT physical forecasts are absent and the exact exposure-restricted historical upper bound is 136 months under current Databento coverage. Under the stated Gaussian planning approximation, that sample is insufficient for a 1% MDE versus zero under the primary dependence screen; the result is conditional and does not establish impossibility, full survivor-rule performance, or the precision needed to rule out true improvements of 1% or more. feas-022 scored no A/B/C outcomes and all protected confirmation evidence remained unopened. #348 therefore remains open and no scored successor is authorized.
revisit_trigger: For the #348 target-matched bottleneck mapping, first revisit the capacity rule and GO criterion without outcome scoring. If that review still warrants investment, implement and verify exact target/futures mapping with an eligible-month manifest, specify the simplest defensible target-month PIT physical forecasts and construct them only as justified, recompute exact aligned OOS capacity, and preserve prospective or independently proven untouched confirmation. A new scored identity still requires explicit operator authorization. Other Line-005 HOLD/REDESIGN blockers retain their own triggers.
selection_basis: Fresh external-literature mapping under programme 002; no legacy internal result is used as scientific calibration or expected outcome.
tested_role_target_horizon: rep-021 tested a narrower one-month log nominal Henry Hub specification and remains INCONCLUSIVE. feas-022 then tested no outcomes; it assessed whether #348's intended one-month calendar-average target, delivery-month futures baseline, target-period realized physical inputs, forecast-time counterparts and candidate 1% capacity criterion are feasible. The resulting state is HOLD pending named data/capacity remedies, with the capacity criterion itself requiring bounded methodological validation.
why_zoomed_in: Production, demand, LNG, storage and other fundamentals need source-specific timing and frequency contracts before they can support explanation or forecasting.
